dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, when this is all over, I'm gonna invite you around for a drink of—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, whoa! Stop thinking about Mondstadt's wine and keep your head in the game! You can't be daydreaming about alcohol before a battle!

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Huh? Alright, just trying to lift our spirits a little... Uh... Oh — you wanna see some photos I took of me and the knights before the expedition, maybe?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shut up, shut up, shut up! Can we please just focus on finding the Wolf Spirit fragment!?
